entities.name: mCPBA
observations: The second component is consistent with meta-chloroperoxybenzoic acid, a peracid used for heteroarene N-oxidation.

entities.name: Dichloromethane
observations: The third component parses as ClCCl, corresponding to dichloromethane and commonly serving as solvent.

entities.name: Iodinated tetrahydroquinoline
observations: The first component is a nonstandard bracketed representation of an iodinated partially hydrogenated quinoline-like heteroarene with one ring nitrogen.

entities.name: Quinoline N-oxide formation
observations: A peracid such as mCPBA commonly oxidizes a pyridine-like ring nitrogen to the corresponding N-oxide without replacing the aryl iodide.
